description: This file defines the main Application container component for a React-Redux e-commerce web app. It manages routing, user authentication state, and UI layout, including navigation, notifications, and footer.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: Main React component managing routing, layout, and user session handling for the app.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component and binds event handlers.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches user profile if token exists, sets up event listeners for storage, keyboard, and mouse events.

methods.name: handleStorage
methods.description: Handles storage events, specifically updates cart when CART_ITEMS key changes.

methods.name: handleTabbing
methods.description: Adds a CSS class to indicate keyboard navigation when Tab key is pressed.

methods.name: handleMouseDown
methods.description: Removes the keyboard navigation CSS class when mouse is used.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the main application layout with routing and components.
